title: La Réunion — MNT réel IGN RGE ALTI
producer: Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière (IGN)
attribution: © IGN — RGE ALTI, Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0. Extraction WMS au pas de 25 m.
sourceDataType: MNT / bare-earth digital terrain model, not a surface model
sourceProductGridSizesNote: Product specifies 1 m and 5 m grids; this WMS export is sampled at 25 m. Local acquisition accuracy and pyramid resampling are not established by the export.
verticalAccuracyNote: 25 m is sample spacing, not altitude accuracy. Quantization error below 0.051 m is additional encoding error only.
verticalReference: Normal altitudes supplied by the IGN RGE ALTI product. No additional datum shift applied; vertical datum is not asserted from the WMS binary response alone.
order: row-major, west to east within each row, north to south rows

encoding.decode: height_m = encoded * scaleM + offsetM; nodata excluded

nodataHandling: Preserved sentinel. Runtime exposes null/NaN for unavailable heights and an ocean surface at zero. Negative source values retained; their bathymetric provenance is not established here.

negativeAltitudeReview.interpretation: Offshore northern sample. Negative value is present in the source at three sampling scales; not introduced by this package. Specific origin and bathymetric accuracy remain unverified.

overview.method: Every fourth sample of the 25 m grid, no invented detail

limitations: 25 m extraction does not resolve paths, rocks, buildings or vegetation.
A finer mesh interpolates samples; it cannot add absent terrain information.
RGE ALTI is historical; acquisition dates vary. Catalog update is not acquisition date.
Negative coastal values retained from source, without a claim of bathymetric accuracy. Zero elevation is a display sea-level choice, not a surveyed coastline.
NODATA does not necessarily mean ocean: land data may be unavailable or withheld.
